description: Search Brazilian companies by a term (`q`) and/or filters (`f`, a JSON string). `tipo` picks what the term matches: `nome` (legal name), `fantasia` (trade name), `socio` (partner), `telefone` (phone with area code), `email` (the full address on record), `endereco` (address) or `cnae` (activity code). Needs a term or at least one filter: a search with neither would scan 71 million establishments.

uf.description: Limits the search to one Brazilian state (two-letter code, such as SP).

name: search
title: Search companies
